title: CONTROL: a slab chunk freed to its class stays inside its page, so the system allocator never sees it end; the Sublet ledger revokes it in mode 1
control_for: the virtual-malloc and virtual-nested-pools arms of memcached/allocator-repros

virtual-malloc.oracle: complete: slabs_free keeps the chunk on the class free list inside a page virtual mallocng sees as one object

virtual-nested-pools.oracle: fault at read_probe: the Sublet ledger revoked the chunk at slabs_free (mode 1)
